# ARCH-13: A driver change holds for every variant and failure it can meet

- A driver serves a family of chips and meets lost devices, bus glitches and timeouts. Check a change against the datasheet of every variant the driver supports, take the timeout path first so a lost sensor always reaches no-data, do not trust a single sample, and behave like the sibling backends: pass on what the sensor reported, and flag every kind of new data. Limit a risky change to the variant that needs it. An SPL06 change would have written the wrong configuration into the SPA06 (peterbarker, [#28983](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/pull/28983)).

Confirmed 2026-10-16. Part of the root playbook, under [Architectural Principles](../claude/CLAUDE.md#architectural-principles). [All architectural rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
